purpose: Define the hard boundary between planning/recommendation/selection under `#SHOP` and any external cart, procurement, ordering or payment operation.

owns: Shopping to Purchase Execution Boundary semantics

topics.name: Shopping to Purchase Execution Boundary
topics.purpose: Define the hard boundary between planning/recommendation/selection under `#SHOP` and any external cart, procurement, ordering or payment operation.

semantics.planning_rule: Shopping-list/item state expresses intent and preparation only.
semantics.selection_rule: Selecting a candidate merchant product is inert planning data.
semantics.external_rule: Creating/updating merchant cart/order is a separate external/canonical operation.
semantics.payment_rule: Payment is always a distinct high-authority operation outside #SHOP planning semantics.
semantics.authorization_rule: Purchase/order/payment operations require their own exact target, validation and AccessCore authorization.
semantics.confirmation_rule: No list state such as selected/needed/completed constitutes payment confirmation.
semantics.price_rule: Observed price/availability is external evidence and may change without changing shopping-item identity.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed external order/payment never marks item obtained/completed unless an explicit reconciled operation does so.

invariants.rule: Shopping-list data expresses planning intent only; list/item existence, ranking, recommendation or selection never authorizes purchase, payment or external order execution.

hard_gates.condition: completed list treated as payment confirmation
price observation becomes canonical transaction truth

references.purpose: External purchase effects cross normal dispatch.

prose.summary: Define the hard boundary between planning/recommendation/selection under `#SHOP` and any external cart, procurement, ordering or payment operation.
